sources.method: Rectangular local XY grid inverse-projected through current TrackRace.buildTrack projection; each actual coordinate queried from public elevation API in batches <=100. No missing-value substitution; heights are source DSM AMSL, not road survey. Array row-major with y increasing south. Actual bounds extend east/south requested bounds to complete 75 m cells.
limitations: 90m DSM may include vegetation/buildings and past terrain; not surveyed road surface or retaining-wall geometry.
Any later rendering blend around track/pits must be documented separately and preserve existing road heights.

limitations: Source video uploaded2025-06-29; recording date is unknown.2024 city photographs corroborate materials only and do not establish current barrier endpoints.

Curb and barrier positions are matched to the observed driving sequence and existing canonical2322m centreline, not a surveyed safety drawing. Endpoints are approximate25–50m, lateral gaps and heights are visual estimates.
Current OSM has no mapped barrier alignments in the inspected track area. These barrier coordinates are generated track-relative approximations, not OSM barrier measurements.

Inside red-white curbs are retained in observed corners; the separate left strip below the rock face is also retained. Curb-free sides and straights use white edge lines, not a continuous perimeter curb.
Covered black protection is represented without claiming a confirmed tire-stack or concrete core. No confirmed sand or gravel in the inspected footage.
Nominal14m road width, canonical timing origin, source centreline, existing smoothed elevation profile and vehicle physics remain unchanged. Original footage and city photographs are not distributed.

Surrounding relief uses391actual Copernicus90m DSM queries sampled every75m; original values575–896m AMSL are preserved. It is bilinearly interpolated and display-scaled1.75once, blended to the existing road corridor and excluded from the infield/pit envelope. Road physics heights and timing remain unchanged.

Mapped woodland boundary is from2020, not an individual tree survey. Dense near-slope tree positions, crown forms and heights are illustrative; broad distant woodland uses a ground material. Rock exposure footprints follow video observations, with estimated extents rather than measured cliff geometry.
